milestone_name: regular type-(iv) source-coordinate and Figure-4 symmetry reduction

locators: Lemma 3.8, printed page 15, extracted lines 494--510: type-(iv) regions have four equal-radius circular arcs and horizontal reflective symmetry, up to density-preserving isometries.
Lemma 3.8 Step 2, printed pages 16--17, extracted lines 533--570: equation (24), the two Snell laws (25), and vertical-axis center alignment force sin(alpha) = sin(beta) = 1/R.
Proposition 3.9, printed page 18, extracted lines 586--596: isoperimetric regions inherit vertical reflective symmetry.
Equation (27), printed page 19, extracted lines 600--619: the type-(iv) curvature parameter satisfies 0 < h <= 1 and the principal exterior angle is arccos(h/lambda).

checked_contract.figure4_scalar_rigidity: The strip-height equation, both Snell equations, principal nonnegative cosine branches, and vertical-axis center alignment imply equal strip-angle sines and a = b = 1/R; horizontal symmetry is a conclusion at this scalar interface.
checked_contract.independent_raw_geometry: RawFourArcCoordinates contains only sourceRadius, exteriorHalfAngle, and horizontalPlacement. Its rectangle, two strip-side circular segments, and two exterior caps are defined directly by circle and half-plane predicates.
checked_contract.strict_regular_profile: SatisfiesRegularSnell supplies lambda > 1, R > 1, the principal exterior-angle branch, and lambda*cos(angle) = 1/R. toCanonicalProfile kernel-derives 0 < h = 1/R < 1.
checked_contract.principal_angle_rigidity: Real.arccos uniqueness derives exteriorHalfAngle = profile.alpha from the source Snell equation and principal branch bounds.
checked_contract.carrier_rigidity: The independently defined five-piece centered carrier is proved literally equal to CanonicalTypeIVProfile.carrier; arbitrary placement is then proved to be a horizontal translate.
checked_contract.representative_lift: An arbitrary sourceCarrier identified almost everywhere with raw.carrier is proved AlmostEverywhereHorizontallyCongruent to the canonical profile. Exact set equality is not claimed for arbitrary finite-perimeter representatives.
checked_contract.cutoff_integration: The relaxed source cutoff and open-range conclusion consume raw regular data plus the visible almost-everywhere source realization, while CompatibleWithModel remains explicit.

scope_boundary: This milestone proves the CMV Step-2 scalar symmetry reduction and normalizes an explicit regular closed type-(iv) representative. It does not prove that every source-admissible minimizer has the required regular four-arc structure, nor does it prove source/reduced-boundary compatibility. Therefore it adds no unconditional density coverage.
next_action: Formalize the upstream GMT classification interface from a source-admissible minimizer to an almost-everywhere regular four-arc representative: reduced-boundary regularity, common-curvature circular pieces, Snell junction laws, interval slices, and exclusion of non-type-(iv) alternatives. Then discharge CompatibleWithModel from the reduced-boundary/frontier identification.
